notes.title: Boo! The Halloween Update is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29536610/5efc8cddd51ae07e03606453302182b797739e34.png[/img]

ːallisonfistː Welcome! It's that spookiest time of the year, and to celebrate, for the first time since the game's launch, we're adding new costume items to dress your contestants in, and all are immediately unlocked - no spinning required! If you've unlocked the ability to select the set for the tower, you'll find that there's a brand new one, Fistenstein's Castle. This bone-chilling tower has new background music, and frighteningly different enemies (except the ghosts... I kept those the same, because ghosts are already spooky enough).

While not particularly scary, this update also includes the Remix Set, which will randomly change the set every 30 floors.

LOOK OUT FOR FRIGHTS!

Update 1.1.0 details:

ːfetfistː Added over a dozen new contestant customization items
ːfetfistː Added 2 new sets: Fistenstein's Castle and Remix Set
ːfetfistː Fixed a bug that made fists display inaccurately for a split second when the floor loads
ːfetfistː Reduced volume of the horse's drop sound effect

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.9 is live!
notes.content:
This is a small patch, but for any of you who got the game on itch.io and redeemed the included Steam code here, you'll find that the itch.io version has also been updated with all the patches made in the past two weeks.

Update 1.0.9 details:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug affecting contestant generation in a later difficulty mode
[*]Fixed a dialogue typo - gonna catch all of them one of these days
[/list]

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.8 is live!
notes.content:
This patch contains some requested fixes and ideas from the Steam community; I'm just one man making all these fixes, but regardless of how expedient I may or may not be, know that I'm listening (or reading, as the case may be).

Update 1.0.8 details:

[list]
[*]Fixed some dialogue typos
[*]Tweaked some of the far jumps in certain floors in order to make them less... harshly precise
[*]Improved custom contestant name entry UI
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed some dialogue typos

tags.balance_change: [*]Tweaked some of the far jumps in certain floors in order to make them less... harshly precise

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.7 is live!
notes.content:
I'm really enjoying watching all of you play this game, be it through streaming, YouTube videos, or just via screenshots posted on the community page; maybe some of you could tag your spoilers better in here, but you're having fun and making progress, and that's what's important.

Anyway, by seeing the game through your eyes, it occurred to me that some fixes needed to be made to the game, which is what I focused on in today's patch.

Update 1.0.7 details:

[list]
    [*]Fixed bug that kept data from saving properly while playing on certain difficulties
    [*]Reduced time between sound effects during credit roll
    [*]Flipped achievement screen so that dialogue isn't obscured by Steam's achievement notice box
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug that kept data from saving properly while playing on certain difficulties

tags.balance_change: [*]Reduced time between sound effects during credit roll

tags.bug: [*]Flipped achievement screen so that dialogue isn't obscured by Steam's achievement notice box

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.6 is live!
notes.content:
Happy Labor Day! Did I ever tell you about the one year where I fell asleep at 9 AM and woke up at 5 PM? I feel like by definition, that is the perfect Labor Day. In stark contrast, on this one, I'm patching Fist's Elimination Tower; don't worry, I got some grilling planned later, it's all good.

Update 1.0.6 details:

[list]
    [*]Fixed a typo in one of the cutscenes
    [*]Added fullscreen toggle to the setup menu
    [*]Tweaked two floors in the Southpaw Tower to make their solutions more intuitive
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed a typo in one of the cutscenes

tags.feature: [*]Added fullscreen toggle to the setup menu

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.5 is live!
notes.content:
I'll admit, I've been watching those achievement stats pretty hard, and I'm impressed with how fast you're making your way through them. That being said, when I realized that somebody got the Southpaw 9 minute achievement and not the 10 minute achievement, I said to myself, "guess it's 1.0.5 time"

Update 1.0.5 details:

[list]
    [*]Fixed bug where Gotta Go Fist! achievement didn't unlock during certain difficulties
    [*]Fixed the ending skip update from 1.0.3 so that it skips the ending cutscene instead of just muting the music for the rest of the cutscene
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug where Gotta Go Fist! achievement didn't unlock during certain difficulties

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.4 is live!
notes.content:
Little update this time, but since it involves a pretty big achievement that I can't award retroactively (my sincere apologies to anybody who has gotten it already), I wanted to put it up as soon as I could.

Update 1.0.4 details:

[list]
    [*]Fixed achievement The Whole Freakin' Show being unobtainable in certain difficulties
    [*]Changed the achievement wording on streak-based achievements to notify the player that, since saving resets the streak, it will prevent these achievements from being unlocked
[/list]

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.3 is live!
notes.content:
Third time's a charm! Here's the third patch to Fist's Elimination Tower, tweaking some audio and adding a requested feature.

Update 1.0.3 details:

[list]
    [*]Reduced volume of menu screen explosions
    [*]Reduced volume of the "bouncing off enemies" chime
    [*]Fixed bug where Allison says "ELIMINATED!" twice if two things eliminate the contestant at the same time
    [*]The ending cutscene can now be skipped by pressing the escape key or start on the gamepad
[/list]

tags.balance_change: [*]Reduced volume of the "bouncing off enemies" chime

tags.bug: [*]Fixed bug where Allison says "ELIMINATED!" twice if two things eliminate the contestant at the same time

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.2 is live!
notes.content:
Another night, another patch for Fist's Elimination Tower! This patch is focused on some things on the Casting page, where, if the achievements are to be believed, two thirds of you have already made custom contestants.

Update 1.0.2 details:

[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug that muted all sounds if the save file is created while on the Casting menu. Thanks, Futch!
    [*]Reduced the requirements for the Fake Cat, Real Cat achievement from 100 to 10.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed a bug that muted all sounds if the save file is created while on the Casting menu. Thanks, Futch!

notes.title: Fist's Elimination Tower 1.0.1 is live!
notes.content:
Thanks to everybody who's gotten Fist's Elimination Tower so far! I hope you're enjoying it, and for those of you who have posted issues about it, I uploaded a patch that should fix some of them.

Update 1.0.1 details:

[list]
    [*]Added fullscreen toggle (press F while on the menu screen - I'll add a more intuitive way in a future patch, which will require an overhaul of the setup screen)
    [*]Tweaked floor transition code to prevent mid-floor freezing
    [*]Fixed a line break in Allison Fist's dialogue caused by playing in Open Fist mode
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added fullscreen toggle (press F while on the menu screen - I'll add a more intuitive way in a future patch, which will require an overhaul of the setup screen)

[*]Fixed a line break in Allison Fist's dialogue caused by playing in Open Fist mode
